===Levels 5–25: Bakery stalls===
From level 5 to 25, steal from the eastern [[bakery stall]] in [[East Ardougne]] market. Stand under the baker to avoid getting caught by the guards, and drop the loot. Players can gain up to 19,200 experience per hour. [[Tea stall|Tea]] and [[silk stall]]s offer worse experience rates than bakery stalls due to slower respawns.
